svg.title: Nairobi County and unreviewed river-study sampling points
svg.desc: A simplified outline of Nairobi County with 10 points from a 2021 Ngong River water-quality study. Points indicate sampling locations where the paper reported nearby dumping, not dumpsite footprints or verified current conditions. 0 points fall outside the county polygon and require review.
